evidence: Root stug-1x4.dat at raw z=-10 and stug-1x6.dat at raw z=10 establish ten external top axes. Raw y=8 rim polygons, y=4 inner cover, and the four transformed s/7904s01.dat rounded-corner rims establish the ten corresponding nominal underside positions. Removed corner cells (raw x=+/-50,z=-10) have no connectors.

The separately inspected central receiver follows root stug4-1x5.dat at raw [0,4,0] with diag(1,-1,1), then its identity-transformed central stud4.dat. The pinned stud4.dat inner cylinder has radius 6 and raw y=-4..0, giving root raw y=8..4 and canonical y=-8..-4. Its open mouth at canonical [0,-8,0] accepts the nominal radius-6, height-4 stud cylinder without changing the part origin. Only this centre tube is added as an explicit receiver.
limitations: The other four tube axes at raw x=-40,-20,20,40 remain unsupported; this record is not a general rule turning internal tube primitives into sockets.
Nominal coaxial diameter, depth and seating do not establish real tolerances, clutch force, strength or a physical build. The receiving tube is not a visible source landmark.

evidence: The identity-transformed s/22385s01.dat has a rectangular rear underside with raw x=+/-16 inner walls, z=-8.35..26, a raw y=4 ceiling and y=8 rim. limitations: The angled nose region at raw z=-20 and its support rib are not exposed as sockets. No stud axis is inferred merely from a tube primitive.
